question: _______ is a location based F2S (Farm to Shop) trading platform, which helps Indian farmers to sell their produce directly to the consumer without middlemen.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mandi Trades**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mandi Trades** is a **location-based Farm-to-Shop (F2S) trading platform that enables Indian farmers to sell their produce directly to consumers, eliminating middlemen**.
 
• This helps farmers achieve better prices and enhances market efficiency.
 
• The** system aims to empower farmers through alternative markets,** wastage reduction, and lower transport costs
 
• The platform offers live price updates from government servers, auto-geo tagging of farms, and allows farmers to create their own online stores

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Safal**

 
 
• **​Safal** is a well-known brand under **Mother Dairy**, which is a subsidiary of the National Dairy Development Board (NDDB).
 
• It **operates in the fruits and vegetables segment and is one of India’s first organized retailing ventures for perishable produc**e.
 
• Safal procures fresh produce directly from farmers, reducing the involvement of middlemen.
 
• This ensures better pricing for farmers and fresher produce for consumers.
 
• Safal operates over **400 retail outlets** in the Delhi-NCR region.
 
• It also supplies to major institutional buyers like hotels, caterers, and other retail chains.
